summary: AdvanSix Inc. filed an 8-K on August 7, 2026, reporting Q2 2026 financial results via press release, with sales of $421 million, EPS of $0.12, adjusted EPS of $0.19, and operating cash flow of $10 million. It also announced a routine quarterly dividend of $0.16 per share payable September 1, 2026. The filing is a standard earnings and dividend announcement, not a special situation. No M&A, strategic review, or corporate action warranting classification was disclosed.
